pieces.Text: A psychic detective has the following spells on her spell list, in addition to psychic spells of 6th level or lower. 1st-Detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, find traps. 3rd-Calm spirit*, daylight. 4th-Modify memory. 6th-Banishment, moment of prescience, scrying (greater). This ability replaces alchemy.
